name: keysready
description: KeysReady: online booking, live repair status and pay-by-phone estimates for small auto repair shops. The app is in web/, the landing page in landing/.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix landing ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix landing run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix landing run typecheck
scripts.build: SESSION_SECRET=${SESSION_SECRET:-build-only-not-a-real-secret} npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix landing run build
scripts.release:check: release-kit check && npm run setup && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
